label: late-episode D2 after choosing a2 (following a rewarded trial)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass) and only late in the episode: zero activity before trial ~60, rate rising steeply over trials 70-99 (5.4x lift in 90-99). 95% of mass is on D2 steps after the agent chose a2 (in_action == 2), 93% with prev_reward == 1; it never fires at D1/GO or when the reward input is 1. Activation is larger when the model value is low and when a2 was chosen while S1 is the hidden good state or after a rare-rewarded trial (top activations ~1.0 are a2 -> S2 common following a rare-rewarded a2 trial), while a2 -> S2c streaks with S2 good give only weak activations (~0.05). The predicate D2 & ep_trial>=70 & action==2 & prev_reward==1 captures ~88% of mass on dev, but precision is low (~0.21) because the feature fires on only a fraction of matching steps and its rate keeps rising with trial index, so it looks like a late-episode timer mixed with an a2-choice signal. All variables are observed at D2 (action is the shown in_action); ep_trial is not an input but can be tracked internally.
